'Earth Bond - If an EARTH card was pitched to play THIS, this gets +1{p}.'

PITCHED_FOR_THIS is the cards pitched to pay for this card, which play._pitch_for_cost stamps on it -- not the pitch ZONE, which holds everything pitched this turn and would stay true for every later attack. Earth is a TALENT, and the condition reads class and talent together, which is what the Bond keywords name.
